notes.title: Fix for co-op spawning
notes.content: Player 2 will now spawn in the appropriate location

notes.title: Fixed "double door" glitch & more
notes.content:
Fixed "double door" glitch that was causing the player to appear in a random location after teleporting;
Fixed issue that allowed players to walk off-screen, crashing the game

notes.title: Linux support improvements
notes.content: Linux support improvements + Fixed paths on ice

notes.title: New collision detection system + Linux support!
notes.content:
Movement and collision detection now use an AABB system instead of a grid-based system, as a result, more precision in knife throwing, smoother and more responsive movements.

Finllay built and tested on SteamOS 3.6.2 and PopOS 22.04 LTS, works like a charm!

notes.title: Fast travel, Pvp Arena Beta
notes.content:
Players can now unlock fast travel, available after visiting 4 cities.

(BETA) Pvp Arena is now available in Duskhaven, just enter and select the number of players.
(Requires one controller per player)

notes.title: Fixed crash when entering desert buildings
notes.content: Fixed crash when entering desert buildings

notes.title: Bugfixing!
notes.content:
- Fixed issue with PS controllers
- Game balancing
- Local co-op up to 4 players

notes.title: Local co-op
notes.content: You can now play with friends using local co-op
